smallest_prospective_probe.P1_runtime_smoke: Only after P0 required bindings and serialized native receipt: exact local model load plus one12s eligible TRAIN/retrospective clip, one fixed layer group, FP32/eval/no-grad. Stop if offline load, dtype, finite shape or storage/runtime checks fail. Runtime path repair and smoke are not a model-training experiment.
smallest_prospective_probe.P2_causal_instrument: One frozen rhythm group layers15-16 (the already reported JD incumbent choice; disclose selection). Trailing8s context at2Hz output timestamps as a concrete proposed design, no hyperparameter sweep. Pool only representations available by output time; retain right-edge support and causal resampler delay. One suffix-perturbation test across several cut points validates complete predictor feature path; stop on any pre-cut change beyond frozen numerical tolerance. Full-trackmean centering prohibited in causal branch.
smallest_prospective_probe.P3_missing_Oslo_endpoint: If >=3 independently qualified canonical titles remain, grouped leave-title-out probe; pair repeated slots across both mixes. For the four-title complete cohort: max4 PCA32 decompositions fit on TRAIN titles only, one fixed random-projection matrix from recorded seed, and max12 ridge fits (3arms x4folds): bus-causal-spectral (64mel+23scalars), bus+random32, bus+MERT32. Fixed ridge lambda and one timescale2s; no search. Train once on fixed offline-feature TRAIN fold and report both offline and causal inference using the SAME fitted coefficients, explicitly naming the distribution-change estimand. If independently trained causal counterpart is wanted, separately declare max24 ridge fits; do not silently add them. Alternative design choices must be fixed before registration; do not execute both12-fit and24-fit paths adaptively.
smallest_prospective_probe.scope_limits: This is missing Oslo/L0 instrument development and a retrospective secondary evaluation, not a fresh DEV claim, a rerun of old JD feature sweep, or a claim that frozen MERT improves professional LIGHT. Choosing2Hz/8s/one group and beat-free87D bus changes the measurement contract and must be declared. Original correlation wording/threshold were not fully registered; parent must freeze correlation/MAE-vs-median/target spread, nulls, canonical-song uncertainty and success/stop criteria before endpoints.

resource_estimate.runtime_estimate: Historical completed JD extraction332songs took8.7min (saved log). For20.5min Oslo audio, offline pass should be short; trailing8s/0.5s overlap adds~16x encoder audio work. Budget15min GPU+10min CPU and hard60min per job, not a measured guarantee.
